full_name: Julie Guthman | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2017–2018 Social Sciences Frances B. Cashin Fellow University of California, Santa Cruz
bio: As a Radcliffe fellow, Julie Guthman is writing a book that traces how the soil pathogen Verticillium dahliae gave rise to the technologies and institutions that brought the California strawberry industry success yet at the same time locked in a system of production that renders less intensive methods nearly unviable.
